about: E101 INTRADAY-HTF (feat/e101-intraday-htf-reads, NUMBER PENDING): a higher intraday timeframe (30 / 60 / 120 / 240) of the chart's own symbol, resampled from an intraday chart's own bars on the chart's measured grid (interpret.js::periodStamps over intradayBucketStart), read by the host evaluator's tf_merge / tf_live arms and the runtime lane's request (requestAlignment), behind the closed capability request-intraday-htf. Each mutant breaks one rule and must turn its rail red.

mutants.mutant: clock-anchor: the session grid anchors a regular-hours bucket at the clock hour instead of the 09:30 open
mutants.from: if (m >= RTH_OPEN_MINUTE && m < close) anchor = RTH_OPEN_MINUTE + floorTo(m - RTH_OPEN_MINUTE)
mutants.to: if (m >= RTH_OPEN_MINUTE && m < close) anchor = floorTo(m)

mutants.mutant: half-day: the 13:00 early close is ignored, so a half day's last bucket runs to 16:00
non-multiple: a target that is not a whole number of the chart's bars is accepted (45 -> 60)
mutants.from: if (m % b !== 0) return `'${c}' minutes is not a whole number of this chart's '${String(base)}' minute bars`

mutants.mutant: partial-first: a chart starting mid-bucket is taken as starting its bucket, so the partial bucket is drawn
session-mask: a chart on neither measured grid is not withheld by name (its read reads as na)
mutants.from:
if (!unplaced) return null
  nameChartClock(opts, [INTRADAY_HTF_SESSION_CODE], opts && opts.tf)
mutants.to:
if (unplaced || !unplaced) return null
  nameChartClock(opts, [INTRADAY_HTF_SESSION_CODE], opts && opts.tf)

mutants.mutant: bar-time: the resampled bucket's bar keeps the day stamp instead of its start's unix second
mutants.from: out.push({ t: start === null ? iso : start, o: b.o, h: b.h, l: b.l, c: b.c, v: b.v || 0 })
mutants.to: out.push({ t: iso, o: b.o, h: b.h, l: b.l, c: b.c, v: b.v || 0 })

mutants.mutant: gate-open: the door builds the read whether or not the capability is admitted (a member's chart moves)
mutants.from: if (!this.intradayHtfReads || other !== null || own === null) return null
mutants.to: if (other !== null || own === null) return null

mutants.mutant: grid-swap: a regular-hours chart is put on the clock grid
mutants.from: export const INTRADAY_HTF_GRID_BY_KIND = Object.freeze({ regular: 'session', extended: 'clock' })
mutants.to: export const INTRADAY_HTF_GRID_BY_KIND = Object.freeze({ regular: 'clock', extended: 'clock' })
